lines.zh: 巡逻的勇士，斧柄不离手。
lines.en: On patrol, the champion never lets go of his axe handle.
My goblin axe rides on my shoulder.
The shield hangs from my other arm.
I walk steady, my steps loud.
I've guarded this road for years.
I stop at the gate and look.
Light comes through the fence gaps.
My boots leave deep prints in the mud.
My kin step aside when I pass.
I head for the watchtower.

lines.zh: 手里的斧头换了个方向。
lines.en: I shift the axe to the other side.

lines.zh: 我听见林子那边有动静。
lines.en: I hear something in the wood.
I walk slowly, but never look back.
I climb the stone steps one by one.
I stand motionless at the village gate.
Wind passes over my shoulder guard.
I stare at the treeline.
My hand is on the axe haft.
When I'm silent, the village is silent.
I knock my shield twice.
Dust falls off my boots.
I'm waiting to see who comes first.
No one wanders this road freely.

lines.zh: 哥布林盾搁在脚边，我守着。
lines.en: My goblin shield rests at my feet as I watch.
I sharpened my axe this morning.
My kin are all watching me.
I wipe the shield rim clean.
The horn still hangs on the stake.
You've come this far.
One more step and you're at the gate.
You're carrying a weapon.

lines.zh: 那你就不是来换东西的。
lines.en: So you're not here to trade.
I don't ask names.
Put your shield down.
Your hand is too close to your axe.

lines.zh: 你的手一抬，我的盾就举起来。
lines.en: Your hand lifts and my shield comes up.

lines.zh: 站得直没用，站得住才行。
lines.en: Standing straight is nothing; standing firm is what counts.
I'll grant you that.
The road behind you is empty.
Then no one is coming to help.
You may take a step back.
I won't chase this time.
Raise your hand and I raise my shield.
The champion looks at you, then at your axe.
Your blow has some weight.
I dug my heel into the mud and held.
A mark on my shield.
I blocked that one off-center.
You're tougher than you look.
I clench my teeth.
A chip of paint came off my pauldron.

lines.zh: 哥布林盾一举，斧就藏在后面。
lines.en: Goblin shield up, axe waiting behind it.
I know that much.
Then come.
What are you holding that up for?
The village isn't short of food.

lines.zh: 别拿肉晃，我的盾会先动。
lines.en: Do not wave meat at me; my shield moves first.

lines.zh: 我不会为一块肉放下斧头。
lines.en: I won't set down my axe for a piece of meat.
Your hand is still reaching.

lines.zh: 食物放门口，人退到桥外。
lines.en: Leave the food at the gate and step past the bridge.
Keep it yourself.
I never take things from strangers.
You're testing me.
I can see that much.
You hit my shield.

lines.zh: 勇士的肩，顶得住你的冲撞。
lines.en: A champion's shoulder holds against your charge.
Your shoulder made a loud knock.
Don't shoulder into a village goblin.
I raise a hand to fend you off.
Your strength will not move me.
We collide side to side.
I knocked you off balance.

lines.zh: 我的护甲撞到你的肋骨。
lines.en: My armor met your ribs.
Another charge ends the same.
Village matters follow the rules.
I don't handle that.
My duty is to guard the gate.
You're asking the wrong goblin.
They're in the huts.
I don't go through that door.
I have my post.
Say it standing here.
I'm still not putting down the axe.
You've said it. The road is that way.
I weigh it on my shield.
It's iron.
I stuff it into my pocket.
Who dropped this?

lines.zh: 我的盾一横，你打不进来。
lines.en: Shield across, and you cannot get in.
This isn't from the village.
I'll take it to the watchtower.
It's too light.
I have no use for it.
Take it back.
You put your hand on your weapon.
Then there's no turning back.
I block first, then strike.
That's the village way.
The ground you picked is level enough.
Good enough that one axe swing covers it.

lines.zh: 我举起哥布林盾，先挡再砍。
lines.en: Shield up first, then the axe.
I can see it.
Your left knee is bending.
I've waited long for this.
I raise the shield over my chest.
The axe is waiting for you to come close.
You circled left.
There's a stump on that side.
And you did pause.
I step forward half a pace.
My shield rim presses your weapon.
You can't pull it free.
Back up more and there's a wall.
It's nearly the last.
One shield push and you're back.
The axe blade comes from the side.
The second blow is the haft.
It lands on your ribs.
You double over.
I ram the shield rim at your face.
I block first, then bring the axe down.
Your arm went numb from that.
The axe comes around again.
You blocked half of it.
I come down from the watchtower.
The villagers part for me.
I walk to the gate step by step.
The axe sways on my shoulder.
Step back past the line.
This crossing is mine to keep.
No one in the village crosses the line.
You came from outside.
I look you over once.
Then state your business.
Fire washed over the shield. Hot.

lines.zh: 从哨塔摔下来，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: I fell from the tower and rolled once.
Water filled my armor and dragged me down.
The blast knocked my shield askew.
An arrow lodged in the shield seam.

lines.zh: 一道光打在我的盾上，散开。
lines.en: A flash hit my shield and scattered.
The village shared food. I took less.

lines.zh: 雷落在我斧头上，我手一麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck my axe and numbed my hand.

lines.zh: 虚空里连站脚的地方都没有。
lines.en: Not even a foothold in the void.
